card.name: Percent sign after a single digit
card.fires_on: The percent sign right after a single-digit number (such as 6, 8, 9) in drug-label text. It is seen in adverse-reaction rates and in solution strengths.

modes.label: Event rates
modes.description: Percent sign after a digit giving the share of patients with a reaction or lab change.
modes.example: Infusion-related reactions were reported as mild in 8<<%>> of patients and as moderate in 5

modes.label: Solution strength
modes.description: Percent sign after a digit giving the concentration of an infusion fluid or nutrient.
